top.title: US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia arrested in UK
top.summary: The 41-year-old was arrested on suspicion of offences under the National Security Act which relate to Russia, police say.

articles.title: Senior US Army soldier arrested in UK on suspicion of spying for Russia
articles.summary: U.K. police arrested a senior U.S. Army soldier in a Russia-linked espionage probe, drawing a sharp warning from FBI Director Kash Patel.

articles.title: US soldier arrested in UK for suspected ‘espionage’ for Russia
articles.summary: A senior U.S. soldier was arrested in Britain on suspicion of assisting Russian ​intelligence, British police said on Tuesday.

articles.title: U.S. Army officer arrested in U.K. on suspicion of trying to steal secrets for Russia
articles.summary: The suspect, 41, who had been “entrusted with sensitive information,” was arrested on suspicion of espionage, according to U.S. and British authorities.

articles.title: US soldier arrested in UK on suspicion of spying for Russia
articles.summary: London Metropolitan Police says its 'counterterror' forces worked closely with the FBI and US military to make arrest.

articles.title: US soldier arrested in Britain on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence
articles.summary: UK police arrested a senior member of the US Army on Tuesday on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence, adding that the arrest was not related to other counter-terror investigations. The 41-year-old man was detained near the city of Gloucester, west England, and remains in custody.

articles.title: US Soldier Is Arrested in UK on Suspicion of Spying for Russia
articles.summary: The 41-year-old man, who was not named, was in custody pending possible charges after a joint investigation with the F.B.I. and U.S. military intelligence.

articles.title: British counterterrorism police arrest US soldier accused of spying on behalf of Russia
articles.summary: A member of the US Army has been arrested in near Gloucester in England. Police said he was suspected of espionage activity in connection with Russia. Investigators from the US and UK are involved in the probe.

articles.title: US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia arrested in UK
articles.summary: The 41-year-old was arrested on suspicion of offences under the National Security Act which relate to Russia, police say.
